activity_summary: At the morning rehearsal you were Navarre at two, for a May Day house in its best clothes. Garnish keeps the licensed book through the comedy and will loose it after Saturday's house. Kemp's lines stay as they are. No new tally was made. You did not show him the king's page.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the part and refused a new tally.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Held the book through the comedy.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Kept the lines already in the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Did not show the king, and did not take the book.

facets.activity: Left the licensed book with Garnish through the comedy

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The book stays in my hand through the comedy.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: I have what is in the book.
